Adding Multiple Copy Buttons in Bitty

July 2026

bitty has a .quickCopy() method. It copies the content of an element and signals the status by updating the text of the copy button to let you know it worked.

For example:

<div data-r="copyExample1">
  The quick brown fox
</div>
<button data-s="copyExample1">Copy</button>
<div data-r="copyExample1">
  The quick brown fox
</div>
<button data-s="copyExample1">Copy</button>
